# Action filter

`cinnabar:extension/action-filter@0.1.0`

Policy-free decisions on resolved, source-backed button actions.

**Grants:** `controls` to run the optional filter-actions export; this interface defines its shared types.

## Types

<a id="type-filtered-action"></a>

### `filtered-action`

Closed in this version; additional actions require a new optional export.

```wit
enum filtered-action {
    attack,
    item-use,
}
```

| --- | --- | --- |
| `attack` |  |  |
| `item-use` |  |  |

<a id="type-transition-kind"></a>

### `transition-kind`

Repeat is an authorized pulse on physically held attack, not another device press.

```wit
enum transition-kind {
    press,
    release,
    repeat,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `press` |  |  |
| `release` |  |  |
| `repeat` |  |  |

<a id="type-transition"></a>

### `transition`

One resolved edge, with the physical held state immediately after it.

```wit
record transition {
    action: filtered-action,
    kind: transition-kind,
    held-after: bool,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `filtered-action` |  |
| `kind` | `transition-kind` |  |
| `held-after` | `bool` | Resolved physical hold after this edge; another binding may still hold the action. |

Types: [`filtered-action`](action-filter.md#type-filtered-action), [`transition-kind`](action-filter.md#type-transition-kind).

<a id="type-held"></a>

### `held`

| `attack` | `bool` |  |
| `item-use` | `bool` |  |

<a id="type-action-frame"></a>

### `action-frame`

One ordered action batch with continuity and real-time evidence for guest policy.

```wit
record action-frame {
    epoch: u64,
    time-us: u64,
    physical: held,
    logical: held,
    transitions: list<transition>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `epoch` | `u64` | Changes on owner replacement, callback failure or input-authority interruption.<br>Clear guest policy state on a change. Suppressed gestures stay suppressed until<br>physical release; retained releases are completed before this batch. |
| `time-us` | `u64` | Absolute monotonic real time, in microseconds; idle callbacks may be skipped. |
| `physical` | `held` | Held states immediately before transitions, after reset reconciliation. |
| `logical` | `held` |  |
| `transitions` | `list<transition>` |  |

Types: [`held`](action-filter.md#type-held), [`transition`](action-filter.md#type-transition).

<a id="type-action-verdict"></a>

### `action-verdict`

One decision per transition plus explicit completion of retained releases.

```wit
record action-verdict {
    accepted: list<bool>,
    release: held,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accepted` | `list<bool>` | Exactly one decision per transition, in order. False suppresses the edge. |
| `release` | `held` | Completes retained releases before the batch. Ignored for physical holds. |

Types: [`held`](action-filter.md#type-held).
